title: Conduct Hold on Debit-Card Cashouts, Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
**Support desk guidance — Cartwise Shopper Payouts, instant cashouts to an external debit card**

A cashout conduct hold is kept back: a shopper carrying 6 or more active violation points keeps back 20.00, a shopper carrying 1 to 5 keeps back 8.00, and a shopper carrying none keeps back nothing. The hold stays on the payout balance and is not sent in the cashout.

**Where the points are read.** The active violation points are the violation points balance on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record at the time of the cashout — points from recorded violations that have not been cleared or expired.

**Input — judgement — output.**

| Active violation points | Band | Hold kept back |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | none | nothing |
| 1 | 1 to 5 | 8.00 |
| 5 | 1 to 5 | 8.00 |
| 6 | 6 or more | 20.00 |
| 9 | 6 or more | 20.00 |

**Boundary.** Five points is the top of the lower band (8.00); six points is the bottom of the upper band (20.00). The hold is a flat amount in each band and does not rise with further points.
